Messages.Author: Malcolm McCallum
Messages.Body:
It is impossible for an opponent to have the card as it is Unique. One of
the nice aspects of it is that you can trade (or give) cards that are in
play. How about this one: In your untap phase, swap the Succubus club for
a ready Vampire, do an action with him and then, in the other fellow's
untap phase, swap back. Throw in a few blood as required.

Messages.Author: Hage
Messages.Body:
Malcolm McCallum wrote:
>
> How about this one: In your untap phase, swap the Succubus club for
> a ready Vampire, do an action with him and then, in the other fellow's
> untap phase, swap back. Throw in a few blood as required.

Sorry, no can do. The Succubus club can only be used during the untap
phase of its controller, so the vamp can't be returned in time.

Messages.Author: Malcolm McCallum
Messages.Body:
When you swap the actual Succubus Club card for the vamp, the other
fellow becomes the controller of the card, neh? I think the real question
for rules lawyers is: If you get a tapped vampire during your untap
phase, can you untap it?


Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Hage <ha...@cs.utwente.nl> writes:

>Malcolm McCallum wrote:
>>
>> How about this one: In your untap phase, swap the Succubus club for
>> a ready Vampire, do an action with him and then, in the other fellow's
>> untap phase, swap back. Throw in a few blood as required.
>Sorry, no can do. The Succubus club can only be used during the untap
>phase of its controller, so the vamp can't be returned in time.

That's why you *swap* the Club for the vampire - then when the vamp's
previous owner (who now controls the Club) untaps, she can swap it back.
